name: Monitor
tagline: Tells you when a site, app or device goes down.
description: Monitor keeps checking your websites, apps and devices and shows which ones are up. It keeps a history so you can see when something went down and for how long. It is built on Uptime Kuma, a free and open-source monitoring tool.
whatsNew: Installs on your box with saved files, live status and start and stop controls. Finish account setup when you first open the app.
